api/src/services/mcp_server/__init__.py.name: Assistant connection package
api/src/services/mcp_server/__init__.py.description: Marks the part of the platform that lets AI assistants sign in and use Bifrost tools.

api/src/services/mcp_server/agent_scope..name: Agent-specific connection
api/src/services/mcp_server/agent_scope..description: Reads which agent an assistant connection belongs to, so only that agent's tools are offered.

api/src/services/mcp_server/auth.py.name: Assistant sign-in
api/src/services/mcp_server/auth.py.description: Signs an AI assistant in through the platform's normal accounts and issues it a limited pass.

api/src/services/mcp_server/authorizatio.name: Assistant permission check
api/src/services/mcp_server/authorizatio.description: Rechecks the signed-in person's current rights on every tool call instead of trusting what was sent.

api/src/services/mcp_server/config_servi.name: Assistant connection settings
api/src/services/mcp_server/config_servi.description: Stores and caches the settings that control which assistant connections are switched on.

api/src/services/mcp_server/gateway.py.name: Live agent and tool lookup
api/src/services/mcp_server/gateway.py.description: Finds the agents and tools a signed-in assistant may use and runs the one it picks.

api/src/services/mcp_server/generators/_.name: Tool registration helpers
api/src/services/mcp_server/generators/_.description: Holds the small helpers that attach the signed-in context to each registered tool.

api/src/services/mcp_server/generators/f.name: Tool registration
api/src/services/mcp_server/generators/f.description: Registers a tool and hands it the current signed-in context automatically.

api/src/services/mcp_server/middleware.p.name: Tool visibility rules
api/src/services/mcp_server/middleware.p.description: Decides which tools each assistant connection can see: a discovery set for general use, one agent's tools for scoped use.

api/src/services/mcp_server/run_package..name: Assistant setup package
api/src/services/mcp_server/run_package..description: Builds a ready-made plugin and setup instructions so someone can connect their AI assistant in one step.

api/src/services/mcp_server/schema_utils.name: Schema to help text
api/src/services/mcp_server/schema_utils.description: Turns record definitions into readable help pages an assistant can show.

api/src/services/mcp_server/server.py.name: Assistant gateway
api/src/services/mcp_server/server.py.description: Runs the connection AI assistants use and exposes platform workflows and tools under strict permissions.

api/src/services/mcp_server/tool_access..name: Tool permission planning
api/src/services/mcp_server/tool_access..description: Works out which agents and workflows a person can reach, so the assistant offers only those.

api/src/services/mcp_server/tool_result..name: Tool answer formatting
api/src/services/mcp_server/tool_result..description: Shapes each tool's answer into readable text plus structured data the assistant can act on.
